title: Supernotes: Driving Consensus in Crowd-Sourced Fact-Checking
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical framework for synthesizing crowd-sourced fact-checking notes to foster consensus. While it discusses the use of neutral, unbiased language and balances for political leaning, it does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethical frameworks. The inclusion of an 'Ethical Use of Data' section is standard research practice and does not constitute a study of ethics itself.
